# seekrit_group (Data Source)

An existing group (a reusable, org-scoped secret bag), looked up by `slug` or `id`. Use it to compose a dashboard-created group into a Terraform-managed environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "seekrit_group" "observability" {
  slug = "observability"
}

# Compose an existing shared group into an environment Terraform owns.
resource "seekrit_environment_group" "preview_uses_observability" {
  environment_id = seekrit_environment.preview.id
  group_id       = data.seekrit_group.observability.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The group id (`grp_…`). Set this or `slug`, not both.
- `slug` (String) The group slug, unique within the org. Set this or `id`, not both.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (ISO 8601).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (ISO 8601).
